meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按语法结构定位并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按语法结构跨文件搜索和改写代码,而非靠纯文本匹配。
copy.tagline_en: Locate and batch-rewrite code by its syntax shape.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and transform code structures across many files, not just exact string matches.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 ast-grep 按代码语法结构而非纯文字来搜索和改写代码,支持 25 种语言。它能找出形状相同的函数/调用/导入,批量替换(如把 console.log 改为 logger.info),也能执行 YAML 规则扫描。
howto.when: 当你要求做结构化的代码查找或改写,例如“找所有接收 Request 的函数”、“把 console.log 换成 logger.info”、“去掉 as any 类型断言”等;若目标是纯文本(字符串内容、注释、文件名)则用 rg,不触发本技能。

say.text: 把仓库里所有 console.log 改成 logger.info
say.note: 会先预览再实际改,并报告涉及文件数

say.text: 查找所有参数为 Request 的函数
say.note: 按 AST 形状搜索,返回文件与行号

say.text: 按 no-console 规则扫描 src 目录
say.note: 运行 sg scan 并输出违规位置和自动修复选项

howto.what_en: It equips Claude with ast-grep to search and rewrite code by syntax-tree shape rather than literal text across 25 languages. It can find similar functions/calls/imports, apply bulk rewrites (e.g., console.log to logger.info), and run YAML rule scans with file counts.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for structural code lookup or codemods (e.g., find all functions taking Request, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip as any). For plain text targets such as strings, comments, filenames, use rg instead.

say_en.text: Rewrite all console.log calls in the repo to logger.info
say_en.note: Previews first, then applies and reports files changed.

say_en.text: Find every function whose parameter is Request
say_en.note: Searches by AST shape and lists file/line locations.

say_en.text: Scan the src directory with the no-console rule
say_en.note: Runs sg scan and reports violations with auto-fix options.
